findings.title: Preserve keyboard focus after toggling Receive light
findings.description: The new toggle calls submit, which refreshes and replaces the layer stack, but lacks the stable layerControl identity and restoreLayerFocus used by adjacent controls. Keyboard Space activation moves focus to BODY, so subsequent navigation restarts outside the edited layer.
findings.suggestedRepair: Assign a stable JSON.stringify([path, "receives-light"]) layerControl identity, capture restoreLayerFocus before submission and restore after completion using the existing moved-focus guard.

findings.title: Complete implicit XYZ expression dependencies for lights
requirementQuotes: Reuse CE8 transforms, parenting and CE9 property paths/expressions.
`light` layers are implicit XYZ transform dependencies.
findings.description: The newly exposed light.constraintReference.z path inherits anchor.z, but implicitAnchorDependencies only includes Z for threeD or camera layers. An implicit light whose anchor.z expression is 20 and a receiver whose position.z reads that reference evaluates the receiver to 0 or 20 depending on authored layer order. Explicit threeD yields 20 in both orders. The implicit light also misses the anchor/reference self-cycle diagnostic.
findings.suggestedRepair: Treat light layers as implicit XYZ in shared anchor/reference dependency discovery and cover evaluation order, fresh-stage reads and cycle diagnostics.

diagnostics.message: expression dependencies form a cycle: light#transform.anchor.z → light#constraintReference.z → light#transform.anchor.z
